records.utterance: These past few days… I know I haven't been easy to be around.

So, yeah, we haven't been easy to be around. I haven't been easy to be around. Three hours. We can clean up the camp.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.

records.response_truth:

You kept it for emergencies. Okay. We made it without needing it, so in some version of events, maybe that worked out. But the people around you were scared and hungry and holding to the same rules you wrote, and that matters.

Lay it out with everything else. Let's go home clean.

I'd also have been more patient with Michelangelo earlier on. I kept redirecting him back to tasks because I was focused on what needed doing, and that was right, but I could have done it with a little more... I don't know. Less efficiency, more humanity. He was holding a lot.

Other than that — I don't know that I'd change much. The decisions made sense when we made them. That's all you can really ask for.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?

None. They weren't for any practical purpose.

They were for us. To remind us that we were still people out here and not just a survival problem to be solved. I said that to DaVinci when he drew them and I meant it.
